main_text.p: patri suo pie offerunt, rogant supplices, religiosa plane blasphemia, ut hostiam illam benedicere, & acceptam habere velit: Nobis non licet esse tam deuotis: Commemorabimus nos quidem sanctissimum Christi sacrificium (quod Cassander bene monuit) grato q; animo recolemus, non iterabimus: accipiemus oblatum a se patri, oblatumque nobis a patre seruatorem, non patri offeremus; quod vnum, dum (vti par est) recusamus, anathemate Tridentino statim percellimur. Pax ergo hic nulla.Can. Miss. Hostiam Domine suscipe benignus oblatam; & statim Quam oblationem tu Deus in omnibus quaesumus benedictam, adscriptam, ratam, rationabilem, acceptabilem facere digneris, &c.
Munera quaesumus Domine oblata sanctifica, &c. Supraque propitio ac sereno vultu respicere digneris & accepta habere, &c. Consult. de Sacrif.

page.notes: Marginal notes in the left column are small italic and partly damaged; the reading of some abbreviations is uncertain. Left-margin notes were transcribed as a block; their placement within the paragraph is approximate. Star ornaments after the paragraph omitted.
